summary: Keep Goal remediation runtime state outside the implementation diff

delivery.outcome: Keep Goal remediation Planfile and analysis outputs local to the checkout so generated runtime state cannot fail Koru implementation-ticket governance.
nonGoals: Do not delete local Planfile or analysis data
Do not weaken governance ticket ownership or active-status rules
Do not change Planfile or Goal source repositories

architecture.decision: Extend Koru's existing local runtime exclusion boundary to cover analysis output and mark legacy tracked runtime paths skip-worktree in the local index.
architecture.rollback: Revert the runtime exclusion extension; local runtime files remain recoverable in the checkout.

validation.evidence: Focused runtime-boundary regression, lint, managed governance, Docker and whitespace checks.
